Questions and answers

What is Laporan Keadaan Laut?

In this glossary, Laporan Keadaan Laut refers to: Periodic description of significant wave height, period and swell state transmitted for routing and safety assessments.

How is Laporan Keadaan Laut used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Feri P&O Pride of Kent ke Dover VTS: laporan keadaan laut, tinggi gelombang signifikan 1,8 meter, periode swell 10 detik, jarak pandang sedang, over."

Laporan Keadaan Laut matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Laporan Keadaan Laut?

Definition

Periodic description of significant wave height, period and swell state transmitted for routing and safety assessments.

Operational example

P&O ferry Pride of Kent to Dover VTS: sea state report, significant wave height one decimal eight metres, swell period ten seconds, visibility moderate, over.

Localized term

Laporan Keadaan Laut

Localized example

Feri P&O Pride of Kent ke Dover VTS: laporan keadaan laut, tinggi gelombang signifikan 1,8 meter, periode swell 10 detik, jarak pandang sedang, over.
